topic: Tournament-day bag check (one-off, separate from the weekly queue)

body: Pack it the night before, and the morning belongs to the wrestling!
Make your own stories, and rep it proudly!

caption:
Save this one for tournament day! 🤼

Shoes laced and ready. Headgear packed. Clean singlet. Water bottle and snacks. Towel and a good attitude.

Pack it the night before, and the morning belongs to the wrestling, not the scramble!

That's what Let's Wrassle is about. It's the work, the grind, and the people you meet along the way!

Make your own stories, and rep it proudly!

Go check out letswrassleapparel.com to check out our catalog

And of course - Shoot for the stars, even if you can't make it to the launch pad!!
